companion_apps.name: openScale
companion_apps.notes: Account-free local measurement/storage; body-composition values are estimates, not medical measurements.

companion_apps.name: YUNMAI
companion_apps.notes: Vendor app 3.10 was analyzed only for corroboration; its account/cloud features and broad model list are outside this spec.

identity.notes: The broadcast parser additionally requires that the six address bytes echoed in the AD structure match the actual scan address reversed. CoreBluetooth may hide that address, making passive identity/dedup unavailable on that host.

methods.notes: Connected Mini/SE path. Exact YUNMAI-Scale-3 is also accepted through identification.local_names.

ble.notes: Bespoke broadcast matcher: nameless advertisement, service 00001320-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb, and full manufacturer-frame validation. It deliberately has no generic company-ID/service-only match, because either would overclaim unrelated devices. Parse every manufacturer entry and require signature/checksum/address echo before assigning data.

identification.notes: Connected-name matchers come directly from openScale. X/Mini 2S have NO local name and their first two manufacturer bytes are address bytes, not a fixed SIG company ID, so identification.manufacturer_data is deliberately absent. Service 0x1320 alone is only a saved-device/candidate hint: a live assignment requires protocol_details.broadcast_transport's full 14-byte payload, known signature, checksum and reversed-address echo. Never force an unknown YUNMAI model into either parser merely because its name contains YUNMAI.

device.name: YUNMAI Mini / SE / X / Mini 2S
device.notes:
This spec covers TWO incompatible transports. Mini and SE connect to FFE0/FFE5 and exchange XOR-checked frames. X (YMBS-M268) and Chinese Mini 2S (M1827CH) need no GATT connection: they broadcast weight/impedance in a nameless 16-byte manufacturer AD structure with service 0x1320. Mini 2 Wi-Fi, Mini 2, Color, Pro, 3G and other regional names in the vendor app are NOT automatically covered.
Raw weight and impedance are the emphasized values. Any body-fat/muscle/water/ bone/visceral-fat calculation is a vendor/openScale estimate requiring an owner profile, not a medically validated measurement. Broadcast weight and impedance are visible to any compatible receiver in radio range; there is no pairing or encryption on that path.
Connected measurement deliberately has NO generic entity binding: a dedicated handler must validate packet length, XOR, protocol version, target user and nonzero weight before publishing. The independent configuration commands remain a supported surface, so this is not identify-only. Advertised Mini/SE names are candidates only: openScale PR1287 records connected variants that omit the final checksum byte. Those units are OUT OF SCOPE until a sanitized checksum-less vector and model mapping exist; XOR validation is never weakened on units with it.

openness.notes: No official protocol documentation was found. openScale supplies the public implementation and regression corpus; the vendor app independently corroborates only the connected FFE4/FFE9 characteristic pair, not broad model compatibility.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: Wake/step on the scale; no pairing button or PIN is part of either documented path.

exclusivity.recovery: Disconnect the previous GATT client before connecting another. Broadcast variants need no disconnect and cannot be paired to hide measurements.

pairing.notes: Absence of pairing is not profile authorization: connected final frames still require the target user ID to match, and broadcast frames still require address echo.

credentials.notes: No Wi-Fi/cloud key or BLE bond is used. The client must persist the locally generated 16-bit user ID and owner profile for connected decoding. Broadcasts are unencrypted radio telemetry, not private measurements.
stored_on_device: Connected-scale user profile/history (exact reset scope unknown)

factory_reset.description: No official model-specific owner manual was located. Battery removal is not asserted to erase user profiles/history and is not listed as a reset. Guest measurements and local-only storage reduce cloud exposure but do not prove a reset.
factory_reset.effect: No model-specific full factory reset or clearing scope was established.

methods.description: For YMBS-M268 and M1827CH only: scan without connecting, validate service 0x1320 and every manufacturer frame, then publish one final per rearm cycle. Do not attempt profile/time/user writes on this transport.
methods.name: X / Mini 2S passive advertisements

steps.action: Step on the X or Mini 2S to wake it.
Passively collect nameless advertisements and validate service/signature/checksum/address echo.
steps.expect: Only exact 14-byte Android-split payloads with known signature and matching address are accepted.

steps.action: Ignore live/stable for final publication, publish one state-03 final, then suppress repeats until a later live/stable frame rearms.
steps.expect: One measurement per cycle, with zero final impedance allowed for weight-only.

methods.description: For named Mini/SE only: connect, subscribe to FFE4, write an owner-selected profile and current time on FFE9, query protocol version, then step on the scale. Persist the 16-bit user ID for future history/duplicate handling.
methods.name: Mini / SE connected profile and measurement

steps.action: Choose/store a nonzero 16-bit user ID and supply the owner profile to be encoded; test data must be synthetic.
Connect and subscribe to FFE4 before starting measurement.
Write set_user, set_time and query_protocol_version on FFE9 with XOR checksums.
steps.expect: Final responses are accepted only when response type, packet length/checksum, protocol bounds and target user ID all match.

steps.action: Step on the scale and ignore live type-01 updates until a valid final type-02 frame arrives.

causes: The four-byte target field does not match the stored 16-bit user ID. Resend that user's profile or reconnect; never attach it to whichever local profile is active.
troubleshooting.symptom: A connected final frame is discarded as Target user changed.

causes: Check protocol version and packet size first: <0x1e is 18 bytes, 0x1e/0x1f is 20; >=0x20 is not claimed.
troubleshooting.symptom: Weight decodes but an inline composition read is wrong or out of bounds.

causes: Broadcast dedup is armed. A later valid live/stable frame rearms; repeated state-03 frames do not create new history.
troubleshooting.symptom: Only repeated finals, no new measurement.

setup.notes: No account or network provisioning is needed. X/Mini 2S measurements are passive; Mini/SE need an owner-selected local 16-bit user ID and profile before measuring. Medium confidence for documented openScale paths, but this project has no new capture.

rejoin.notes: There is no bond/account binding to move. A new connected client selects and stores its own 16-bit user ID/profile; a broadcast client simply scans. The owner must understand that a new connected profile ID may not match old records.

steps.action: Disconnect the old connected client, if any, and wake the scale.
For Mini/SE, provision the new client's user ID/profile; for X/Mini 2S resume passive scanning.
steps.expect: New final frames match the intended transport and, for connected frames, target user ID.

testing.notes: No scale was driven by this project. Capture detail applies ONLY to the public M1827CH final advertisement whose address-echo bytes were zeroed in openScale's test; X international and connected Mini/SE remain static-analysis evidence. Upstream's focused 28/28 tests are not this project's hardware verification.

variants.notes: Also accepts YUNMAI-ISM*, YUNMAI-ISC2P* and exact YUNMAI-Scale-3 as CANDIDATES only. Measurement support is limited to units whose captured response passes the documented XOR check; openScale PR1287's checksum-less variants are excluded pending a sanitized vector/model mapping. Protocol <0x1e has 18-byte final; 0x1e/0x1f has 20-byte final.
Same candidate-name and mandatory-XOR gate as Mini; complete history/unit management is not claimed. Checksum-less variants are unresolved and excluded.
Nameless; international signature 0b 74 17 plus checksum/address echo required. Service UUID alone is only a candidate hint.
Nameless Chinese variant; signature 06 52 11 with otherwise identical layout and one sanitized public final-frame fixture.

evidence.app_static_analysis: Archived vendor app 3.10 independently references FFE9/FFE4. Its broad model list is explicitly not treated as proof that Mini 2 Wi-Fi, Color, Pro, 3G or other regional revisions use either parser. No account/cloud functions were exercised.

artifacts.description: Connected/broadcast handlers, algorithms, model names and 28 focused upstream tests.

artifacts.artifact: M1827CH sanitized final advertisement in YunmaiXHandlerTest
artifacts.description: Address-zeroed Chinese Mini 2S final fixture; no other captured health data is used.

evidence.checksum_variants: openScale PR1287 (merged 2026-01-18) records connected models that do not append the final checksum byte. It supplies no sanitized checksum-less vector/model map, so those units remain outside this spec. Name prefixes are candidates only; measurement claims require a response passing the same XOR validation used by tests.
evidence.negative_findings: No official model-specific manual/FCC record was established. No history download, medical validation, full profile/unit manager, firmware update flow or generic YUNMAI-name compatibility is claimed.
evidence.open_questions: A real international X frame and connected Mini/SE session are needed, including 0x1320 uniqueness, >=0x20 layouts, profile-ID resync and broadcast rearm timing. Reset/history semantics and CoreBluetooth address-hidden dedup also remain open.
evidence.public_capture: Exactly one M1827CH final frame is preserved in openScale's public test with all address-echo bytes zeroed. It establishes that signature/layout/final values, not international X or connected Mini/SE hardware behavior and not this project's test.
evidence.public_implementation: openScale at 35a67c7eea706d0c0cbd6a48b98f7b352960d0a1 supplies connected names, GATT mapping, XOR framing, set-user/time/version requests, final version bounds, broadcast signatures/checksum/address-echo and final rearming. Its focused YunmaiXHandler/YunmaiLib tests passed 28/28 upstream.

android_split.address_echo: For actual address a0:a1:a2:a3:a4:a5, require manufacturer_id=(a4<<8)|a5 and payload[0..3]=a3,a2,a1,a0. Reject relocated/replayed frames.
android_split.malformed_rule: Reject wrong length, signature, checksum or address echo; unknown states are ignored and never publish/rearm.
android_split.payload_fields: Original offsets 2-15 become payload offsets 0-13: remaining address echo @0-3, signature @4-6, session @7, state @8, weight @9-10 BE, impedance @11-12 BE, XOR @13 over payload 7-12.

broadcast_transport.candidate_rule: Service UUID alone is acceptable only to reopen a saved candidate, never to assign a new measurement; every live frame requires full validation.
final_rearming: Start armed. Live 01 or stable 02 sets armed=true and is consumed without final publication.
Final 03 publishes once only when armed and decoded weight >0, then sets armed=false.
Repeated final while disarmed is consumed without publication. A later valid live/stable frame rearms; session byte is not needed for that decision.
Invalid final weight does not publish and does not manufacture a new measurement.

fields.name: device_address_reversed
fields.notes: Bytes 0-1 become Android manufacturer ID; they are not a SIG company assignment.

fields.name: session
fields.notes: Per-weigh-in byte of unknown purpose; validate but do not compare or decode it.

fields.name: impedance
fields.notes: Zero until final; zero final gives weight-only.

broadcast_transport.privacy: Broadcast measurements are unencrypted and receivable in range; address echo is replay/identity validation, not encryption.

public_sanitized_m1827ch.evidence: openScale public test fixture, final state 03, with all six address-echo bytes zeroed and address 00:00:00:00:00:00.
public_sanitized_m1827ch.scope: Only public captured evidence in this spec. No identity, location, account or additional health history is retained; all other vectors are invented.

synthetic_example.note: Invented address in the documentation range; test builds final weight 80.00 kg, impedance 500 ohms and its XOR.

composition_estimates.history_boundary: No complete history sync, profile manager, unit manager or Wi-Fi variant support is claimed.
composition_estimates.rule: Optional client-side estimates only. Require an owner profile and nonzero impedance; do not turn inline/derived values into medical claims.

connected_transport.checksum_variant_gate: Advertised Mini/SE names are only candidates. Accept measurement decoding only after a response with valid declared length and XOR. openScale PR1287 reports checksum-less connected variants; they are excluded until a sanitized vector and model mapping exist. Never bypass XOR on a checksum-bearing unit.
connected_transport.handler_required: A dedicated connected-measurement handler must complete all response checks before publishing weight/impedance. Configuration commands remain independently consumable; no generic measurement entity exists.

request.checksum: XOR of bytes 1 through the byte before checksum, inclusive; packet_size is total request bytes.

response.capability_boundary: Body-composition read is implemented upstream, but complete history, time sync, user sync and unit configuration are known capabilities not all claimed finished. This spec does not advertise history download.
response.checksum: Same XOR span; reject any mismatch before decoding.

final_layouts.fields: timestamp @5 u32 BE, target @9 u32 BE, weight @13 u16 BE *0.01 kg, impedance @15 u16 BE ohms, XOR @17. No inline fat field.
final_layouts.protocol: below 0x1e (0x13 is the specifically documented example)

final_layouts.fields: Same common fields plus vendor composition value @17 u16 BE *0.01 percent; XOR @19. Meaning is vendor-specific and not clinically asserted.

final_layouts.action: Reject as unknown instead of reading beyond an 18-byte buffer or assuming 0x1e/0x1f layout.

response.live: Type 01 is live/unstable and is not published as a final measurement. Unknown types are rejected.
response.packet_size: Whole response length including 0d and final XOR; require it to equal actual buffer length.
response.sequence: Subscribe FFE4; write set_user, set_time, query_protocol_version on FFE9; ask user to step on scale; accept only valid final type 02.
response.target_user: u32 BE at 9 must equal zero-extended stored 16-bit ID. On mismatch resynchronize profile or reconnect; never attach to active local user by default.
response.timestamp_fallback: If timestamp is before 1980-01-01 UTC, use host receive time.

newer_final.note: Test constructs the same common values plus invented inline 25.00 percent and validates version bounds, not medical meaning.

older_final.note: Synthetic profile/measurement; checksum is independently computed in the test.

remaining_unknowns: International YMBS-M268 capture and whether 0x1320 is unique enough even as a saved-device hint.
Connected Mini/SE capture, protocol >=0x20 layouts, exact meaning of the inline 0x1e/0x1f composition field and any 0x1f boundary differences.
Connected history/unit/profile completion and exact user-ID conflict recovery.
Meaning of broadcast session byte and precise live/stable rearm behavior across weigh-ins.
How to dedup/passively identify broadcasts on hosts that hide the hardware address.
Model-specific reset, stored-history clearing and unsupported regional/Wi-Fi variants.
openScale PR1287's checksum-less connected variants: no sanitized vector or model mapping exists, so they are excluded rather than accepted without XOR.

format.name: packet_size
format.notes: Whole response length including leader and XOR.

format.name: timestamp
format.notes: UNIX seconds; values before 1980-01-01 UTC are implausible and fall back to host time.

format.name: target_user_id
format.notes: Must equal the stored 16-bit ID zero-extended; mismatch requires profile resynchronization.

format.name: impedance
format.notes: Raw resistance; zero is not a valid composition input.

format_match.notes: Final common fields only; type/version/length/checksum validation is in protocol_details.

initialization.notes: Subscribe before profile/start writes so no final response is missed.

services.name: Mini / SE measurement service
services.notes: Connected variants only; X/Mini 2S must not be connected for this protocol.

query_protocol_version.description: Five-byte query: 0d 05 13 00 16; use the answer to select final-frame bounds before measurement.

set_time.description: Set current UNIX time with u32 BE and five zero reserved bytes.

set_user.description: Set the owner-selected profile. Persist its 16-bit ID; response target mismatch must not be assigned to another local user.

characteristics.name: Command writes
characteristics.notes: Requests are 0d | packet_size | command | payload | XOR. XOR covers bytes 1 through penultimate; packet_size is total bytes including 0d/checksum.
